resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts say destroyed in 1957; the Forest Lookouts page says removed in 1957. The year agrees across all three, so the story uses destroyed and notes the wording.

sources.title: Beaver Jack Mtn. Fire Lookout Cabin

notes_for_editor: The brief record had no events; the sources supply the c.1918 camp, the 1920 cabin, the 1945 named lookout and the 1957 end. The sources agree on the dates but differ on the wording of the 1957 fate. Idaho Fire Lookouts credits the 1945 name to the Forest Fire Lookout Page, so it is firelookout.com's record. A genealogy search turned up only family-tree pages, which were not used. The Forest Lookouts page also lists a federal survey station named Beaver Jack (PID QZ0635) reached by helicopter. That is a survey mark on the highest ridge top, not the lookout, and its description does not mention the lookout, so it is left out. No source describes the site today or its access. Do not confuse with the Beaver Peak in Shoshone County (us-id-beaver-peak).
